verification.scope: Five-PR integration, BIOL157 Units 3–8 and Cell completion batch
verification.summary: 224 offline checks and 40 real local Auth/Firestore checks pass with Bio’s expanded 345-question bank, no skips/failures. Lint/build pass with ten existing warnings and the existing large-entry warning. Final Chromium traverses 85 Bio lessons/548 sections and 46 Cell lessons/277 sections at 390px, nineteen combined figures without clipped labels, Unit 5/6/7/8 exact source-feedback links, eight newer Cell citations and full-bank submissions (178/114/345), resume/retry/reload and three private progress panels. Eleven Bio PDF hashes/page counts and 380 literal anchors verified; 101 selected visual pages inspected. Previous Cell PDF/123-page evidence retained, not newly recertified by this enzyme batch. No production test or formal academic sign-off.

deployment.status: Read-only inspection confirms existing Vite project prj_W0ZnmiQ9iO0oyeFPm4HAffXSiheO in the intended team and SSO protection enabled for all deployments. Six Firebase variables are shared across production and preview, with no RC-branch overrides; isolated preview Firebase is not established. No deployment or environment change performed.

blockers: No formal academic sign-off for the final student-visible content.
BIOL157 Units 9–10 not authored; Units 1–8 have substantial source-checked teaching drafts pending academic review.

Cell: all 170 original rationales editorially improved and four review-only question revisions documented; remaining source figures, historical microscopy development, precise concept links, human approval and current-year official scope are unresolved.

Computer: exact manual acceptance steps are prepared but all 15 Microsoft Office desktop scenarios remain unexecuted; four questions withheld; payroll/grading/exactly-40/version ambiguities and 342 unmapped package pages remain open.
Protected preview requires verified existing Vercel project configuration and isolated test Firebase; production rules/auth domains/data separation/rollback not yet verified.
nextCheckpoint: Read all 28 actual Lecture 9 pages and implement both Metabolic Pathways topics as a complete tested batch, then all 48 actual Lecture 10 pages and five Lipids topics with independent source-flag checks. Finish remaining Cell/Computer source and exact-concept gaps, human Office/academic decisions, auditable publication and isolated Firebase/Vercel preview readiness.
